answer: Reputation Decay by Inactivity. Each identity's trust score decays continuously unless it performs verified work, so maintaining N dormant identities costs N times the ongoing audit and renewal burden. A sybil must sustain every puppet's score through real transactions or pay rising reactivation deposits. Think of each new voyage into the system: the longer a shell sits idle, the steeper its re-entry cost. Honest agents earn renewal nectar through genuine activity, while attackers bleed capital on idle inlet accounts.
